name: IT Security
description: Core controls for access, data protection, infrastructure hardening and incident response.

items.text: Multi-factor authentication is enforced for all user and admin accounts
items.guidance: Prioritise email, VPN, cloud consoles and privileged accounts.

items.text: Access follows least privilege and is reviewed quarterly
items.guidance: Remove unused permissions and document review outcomes.

items.text: Joiner, mover and leaver process revokes access promptly
Privileged access is managed through a PAM or vault solution
items.guidance: Rotate credentials and record privileged sessions.

items.text: Sensitive data is encrypted at rest and in transit
items.guidance: Use TLS 1.2+ and platform-managed or customer-managed keys.

items.text: Backups are automated, encrypted and restore-tested
items.guidance: Keep at least one offline or immutable copy.

items.text: Data loss prevention rules cover high-risk channels
items.guidance: Start with email and cloud file sharing.

items.text: Systems are patched within defined SLAs
items.guidance: For example: critical within 14 days, high within 30 days.

items.text: Endpoint protection is deployed and monitored on all devices
items.guidance: Alert on devices that stop reporting.

items.text: Network is segmented to isolate critical systems
items.guidance: Restrict lateral movement between user and server networks.

items.text: Vulnerability scans run at least monthly
items.guidance: Track findings to closure with owners and due dates.

items.text: Incident response plan is documented with named roles
items.guidance: Include contact details and decision authority.

items.text: Security logs are centralised and retained
items.guidance: Retain at least 90 days searchable, longer in archive.

items.text: Incident response is exercised at least annually
items.guidance: Run a tabletop exercise and track lessons learned.
